audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart carried a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer and packet give Lissandra levels 1-6 and Malzahar first item onward.
audit.why: Content whys are grounded (her Q out-ranges, W root all-in, self-R breaks the suppression; Malzahar flips at first item and out-scales). Moved full sides to match and rewrote every why. Packet notes the 53.16% Malzahar winrate versus a 5/7-Lissandra chart — consistent with a lane lost early but won on scaling; left the shape as content/packet has it.
audit.corrected: Full sides now Lissandra x5, Malzahar x2 with matching whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[4] claimed level 6 is a guaranteed kill button; against Lissandra a self-cast Frozen Tomb makes her untargetable and breaks Nether Grasp mid-channel (already stated in content).
audit.why: Frozen Tomb carries the untargetable flag and Riot's text confirms invulnerable self-cast; the two layers now agree that her 6 beats yours and first item is the flip.
audit.corrected: phases[4] rewritten; first-item and late rows moved to Malzahar.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood/tradeBad were the Kassadin 'shield' template; breakdown.cooldowns had no digits plus the fabricated 'Iron Boundary'; content named her E 'Glide' (real name Glacial Path); Grievous Wounds vs the Frozen Tomb self-heal was missing; ~20 fields misgendered her.
audit.why: Kit: Glacial Path 24-12s (engage and escape in one button), Ring of Frost 10s at 450 range, Frozen Tomb 120/100/80s with a self-cast heal — anti-heal timing matters per the missing-interactions file.
audit.corrected: Trades rebuilt on the 24s Glacial Path window, cooldowns field carries real numbers, 'Glide' corrected to Glacial Path, Oblivion Orb note added to spikes[1], pronouns fixed.

edits.before: His poke pops your shield, your shove pops his tempo — the lane is a war between his range and your metronome.

edits.before: Out-shove his tempo, shield-manage his poke, and convert 6 into point-and-click kills. Shorthand: Glacial Path (Claw) down, wave right, go.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Trade only on her downtime: Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1 — when she lands and it is spent, E-Q-W her retreat; she has no second exit for a long time.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Trading with Void Shift down inside her 450-range Ring of Frost — rooted at the squishiest point of the lane, you die to W-Q-R.

edits.before: - Lissandra Glacial Path (Claw): matchup-defining — Her engage and escape in one button — she is immobile while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your spell shield (Iron Boundary) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1 — engage and escape in one button; she is immobile while it is down, and that is your trade window. - Ring of Frost roots on a 10s cooldown at just 450 range: stay outside it. - Frozen Tomb is 120s — a self-cast to break your R empties her for two minutes.

edits.before: Lissandra's window and it lasts a while. Her Q (Ice Shard) out-ranges your poke and her W (Ring of Frost) root sets up an all-in your voidlings can't answer, while E (Glide) gives her the mobility to dive your shove and get back out. Farm safe with Malefic Visions, dodge Q, and never let her walk into W range on you at low HP.

edits.before: You are behind for the entire early game and you have to accept it. Lissandra's Q out-ranges you, her W (Ring of Frost) root turns any misstep into a kill, and E (Glide) lets her engage your shove and glide back to safety. There is no trade you win here, so farm with Malefic Visions from max range, dodge her Q, and keep your health above her W-Q all-in threshold. Don't waste your ult trying to answer her before your items; just survive to your spike.

edits.before: Still hers. Her R (Frozen Tomb) can lock you for the all-in or self-cast to stasis out of your Nether Grasp, breaking the suppression. Her W-Q combo still out-damages your kit, so play under tower and don't duel her yet.
edits.after: Still hers. Frozen Tomb locks you for the all-in or self-casts to stasis out of your Nether Grasp, breaking the suppression — and the self-cast heals her, so an early Oblivion Orb pays off. Play under tower and don't duel her yet.

notes: Full chart was a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows against a content/packet chart of Lissandra x5, Malzahar x2 — moved full to match (win[N] already held the targets, so side edits stand alone per the chart rule). The packet's own defect notes the chart shape contradicts the 53.16% Malzahar winrate; kept the content/packet shape since the whys ground it (lost early, won on scaling), but flagging for the user. Fabricated names removed: 'Iron Boundary' (Malzahar passive is Void Shift) and 'Glide' (Lissandra E is Glacial Path). Missing anti-heal interaction folded into spikes[1]. Report edits beyond two entries are all lint-mandated.
